description: This file contains test scripts for Git clone commands, specifically testing cloning with various '--revision' options such as branches, tags, HEAD, commit hashes, trees, and parent revisions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and checks the outcome.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test completes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified options, such as annotations or tags.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail; outputs error details if it does not.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches output for a specific pattern.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Counts lines in output, used for assertions.
